title: Skaner — receipts and invoices into validated data
meta_desc: Photos and PDFs of receipts, invoices, acts and waybills into validated Excel, CSV, JSON and 1C. Free with your own API key.
bar0: Free with your own Anthropic or Google key · paid plans if you prefer not to
h1a: Receipts and invoices into clean data.
h1b: Excel, CSV, JSON and accounting imports.
lead: Photos and PDFs in, checked data out. Use your own Anthropic or Google key for free, or pay per page.
fine: Sign in with a code sent by email. No password needed.
f1_p: Photograph a document or drag files in batches. PDFs work too.
drop: Drop files here or click to choose
f2_p: Every result is checked, and only the doubtful fields are flagged for you.
f3_p: Receipts, invoices, acts and waybills, including Kazakhstan and Russian-language forms.
f4_p: Excel, CSV, JSON, a text PDF and 1C import files. QuickBooks and Xero are planned.
s1_p: A photo or PDF, one file or a batch.
s3_p: Excel, CSV, JSON or a table for loading into 1C.
prices_h: Bring your key, or pay per page.
prices_sub: Your own Anthropic or Google key: free. No key: pay by invoice, billed per page.
prices_note: More — custom pricing. All plans include Excel and 1C, all document types, multiple team members and the Telegram bot.

byok_title: With your own key: free for you
byok_note: Paste the key of your own Anthropic or Google (Gemini) account: recognition runs through it and you pay us nothing. The key is not stored on our server and is used only for this upload. Your documents go to your provider under its terms. Without a key, processing is paid: the Plans page explains how to pay.
byok_remember: Remember the key in this browser (kept on your device only)
err_byok_bad: This does not look like a key of the chosen provider. Check that you pasted all of it and picked the right provider.
err_byok_blocked: Too many rejected keys today. Check your key and try again tomorrow.
berr_key: The provider did not accept the key. Check the key and that your account can use the models.
berr_quota: Your key's limit or the funds on your provider account have run out.
err_long_parts: One document can have at most {parts} photos or pages.

pl_plan: {plan} plan: {n} of {q} pages left, valid until {date}.
pl_paid: Extra pages with no end date: {n}.
pl_how: For now we bill by invoice: you send a request, we contact you and switch the plan on. A plan lasts 30 days; unused plan pages expire at the end.
pl_mail: Or write to us by email:
pl_over: Pages beyond the plan are not billed automatically: we agree the number and the payment with you, then add the pages by hand.
rq_p: Leave a contact, and we will get in touch and send an invoice.
rq_err_contact: Enter a phone, WhatsApp or Telegram contact, 3 to 80 characters.
rq_err_text: Remove the special characters from the text.
rq_err_long: The text is too long: company up to 120 characters, comment up to 500.
rq_err_email: Please do not enter an email address: leave a phone, WhatsApp or Telegram contact.
rq_err_many: Too many requests today. Please try again tomorrow.
rq_done_p: Thank you! We will contact you using the details you gave.
ac_code_hint: Quote this code when you write to us: it lets us find your account without your email.
ac_stored: A fingerprint of your email (not the address itself), your account code, page balance and your results for {n} days. The uploaded files are not kept. More in the Privacy Policy.
ac_del_h: Delete the account and all data
ac_del_p: The account, history, results and payment requests are deleted. Remaining pages and the plan are lost.
ac_del_keep: What remains: records of page charges and top-ups and the log of the service owner's actions, for accounting and payment disputes (no email, phone or document contents); the email fingerprint marked "trial used" and the fingerprint of a phone that gave trial pages, so that the trial cannot be taken again. Deleted data stays in database backups for up to 90 days.
ac_del_err: Type the word "{word}" to confirm the deletion.
ac_del_active: You can delete the account once processing has finished.
blk_p: Sign-in and uploads are switched off for this account. If this is a mistake, please write to us.
bal_phone: Confirm your phone to get {n} more trial pages.
err_phone: Not enough pages: {need} needed, {left} left. Confirm your phone to get {n} more trial pages: use the "Confirm phone" link above.
ph_h: Confirm your phone to get {n} more trial pages
ph_p: One trial per phone number. The number is confirmed in our Telegram bot with the "Share my number" button. The trial end date does not change.
ph_get: Get a link to the bot
ph_steps: Open the link, tap "Start", then "Share my number". Then come back here and tap "Check".
ph_valid: The link is valid for {n} minutes and works once.
ph_wait: Waiting for the confirmation in Telegram. If the link got lost or did not open, get a new one.
ph_done_p: Your number is confirmed and the trial pages were added.
ph_not_needed: This account does not need to confirm a phone.
ph_many: Too many links today. Please try tomorrow.
ph_used: This number has already received a trial. Sign in to that account or contact us.
ph_other: A different number is already linked to this account.
ph_expired: The link has expired or was already used. Get a new one.
ph_privacy: We do not keep the number itself: only a fingerprint made with a secret key, to give one trial per number.
co_join_p: Once you accept, you work with the company's pages. Your uploads in the company are seen by you and the company owner. Personal uploads made before are not shown in the company.
co_none_p: Create a company to give your staff access.
co_none_p2: Staff use the company's shared pages: your trial, plan and top-ups. Each person sees their own uploads; you see all of the company's uploads.
co_limits: Up to {trial} people including the owner, up to {paid} with a plan.
co_remove_p: A removed member loses access to all of their uploads in the company at once; they stay with you.
co_member_p: Your uploads in the company are seen by you and the company owner.
co_link_p: The link works once and for 7 days. Send it to the person, for example in WhatsApp. It is shown only once.
co_code_p: The person finds their code (SK-XXXXXX) on their Account page. Access opens only when they accept the invitation.
co_code_sent: If such an account exists, the invitation has been sent.
co_code_bad: An account code looks like this: SK-XXXXXX.
co_pending_p: An invitation is valid for 7 days. Once accepted, the person appears in the list above.
co_del_p: Members leave the company. Each upload goes back to the person who made it, as a personal one. Pages and the plan stay in your account.
co_del_active: You can delete the company once processing has finished.
co_leave_p: After leaving you lose access to all of your uploads in the company at once: they stay with the owner. Your personal uploads from before you joined become visible again.
co_owner_leave: The owner cannot leave the company. Remove the members or delete the company.
co_err_name: The name must be 2 to 80 characters, with no email and no control characters.
co_err_already: You are already in a company.
co_full: The company is full: up to {trial} people, up to {paid} with a plan.
co_full_join: This company has no free places.
co_many: Too many invitations. Cancel the ones you do not need or try tomorrow.
co_already: You are already in a company. To accept this invitation, leave it first.
co_pay_owner: The company owner arranges the plan and pages.
join_bad: This invitation is not valid: the link has expired, was used or was cancelled.
err_no_pages_org: Not enough company pages: {need} needed, {left} left.
err_org_blocked: Processing is not available in this company now. The company owner needs to write to us.
ac_del_owner: You own a company that has members. Remove them or delete the company first.
